title: First Day at the Data Desk

newspaper.headline: PT Nusa Digital Opens a Data Desk
newspaper.lead: PT Nusa Digital's data team welcomes a new analyst. The job: pulling numbers from the database with SQL and checking charts before reports go out.

tip.title: Tip: Look at the Axis First
tip.text: Before trusting a bar chart, check where the Y axis starts. If it is not 0, a small difference can look huge.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: An analyst who reads tables carefully. Ask for Laras, 3rd floor.

boss.title: Board Meeting
boss.intro: The board meets soon! Three requests arrive at once: two queries and one chart. Get them all right!
